question: Does one AquaCal solve saturate the box? If not, the accuracy-only stages of the full-suite driver could run N-wide.

cores_busy.note: excludes the first 30 s of startup

concurrency_headroom_on_linux_target.caveat: E1 is the cheapest and smallest solve in the suite. E6/E7 band cells and E2 are larger; peak RSS especially does not transfer. Treat this as an upper bound on headroom, not a setting.
